title: Raw Salmon Miso Nigiri
description: Sashimi-style raw salmon on vinegared rice, brushed lightly with honey-free white miso sauce.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

ingredients.name: Salmon intended for raw consumption, unless cooked

steps: Slice chilled raw-consumption salmon against the grain into six uniform pieces about 4–5 mm thick.
With damp hands, form six lightly packed rice ovals, approximately 25 g each.
Drape one salmon slice over each oval and shape without squeezing tightly.
Brush about 2 g chilled white miso sushi sauce over each piece; optionally finish with a little minced scallion.
notes: Use the sauce lightly, so the salmon remains the dominant flavor.
Baseline makes approximately six light servings. Ingredient quantities can be scaled independently.
Prepare and season sushi rice using its separate recipe.
For uncooked salmon, use a reputable raw-consumption supplier, keep chilled and assemble promptly.
